name: T-PEMF pattern (Re5, 55 Hz bipolar pulses)
origin: Re5 ApS, Denmark; Martiny, Bech and Larsen (Copenhagen, Aalborg)
summary: The pulse timing and coil layout of the Danish Re5 transcranial PEMF device used in depression trials: 3-ms bipolar square pulses every 18 ms (about 55 Hz) for 30 min on seven coils in phase over the temporal, parietal and occipital regions. Martiny 2010 give 1.9 mT at 0.5 cm from a Re5 coil; this helmet gives 22 to 37 uT at 1 cm and 5 uT at 20 mm, so only the timing is copied.
notes: Martiny 2010: the generator's voltage alternates between +50 and -50 V in 3-ms pulses, and seven coils 'connected in parallel' sit in the 'anterior and posterior temporal region on both sides', the 'upper parietal region on both sides' and 'the center of the lower occipital region' (p.2 [164]). Larsen 2020 describe the pulse as +3 ms, -3 ms, then a 12-ms pause (18 ms, about 55 Hz). Tang 2026 describe series pairs (l.59), so the sources disagree on the wiring. This program plays the voltage shape as the field shape, exact at the 0.5-ms step. In the device the coil current rounds the pulse off with a time constant of about 1.5 ms (L = 110 mH, R = 72.5 Ohm, Tang 2026 l.59); Tang's biphasic magnetic pulse of about 4.5 ms (l.55) is the same signal seen as field. T7/TP7, T8/TP8, P3/P4 and Oz are this project's reading of the regions; T7 is mid-temporal, and FT7/FT8 with TP7/TP8 would match 'anterior and posterior' better. All seven coils share one polarity and channel 8 is unused. Martiny give 1.9 mT at 0.5 cm from a coil and 0.22 V/m there (p.2 [164]). The other figures for the induced field are 0.01 V/m as the mean in cortex (Tang 2026 l.63) and 'near 0.0004 V/m' (Larsen 2020 p.3 [2]). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 cm the helmet gives 22 to 37 uT. For Re5 itself there is one positive sham-controlled trial from the originating group (Martiny 2010) and no independent sham-controlled trial among the sources; twice-daily sessions added nothing (Straaso 2014). van Belkum 2021 did not use Re5 but an EEG cap with 19 iron-core electromagnets at 10/20 positions, the same pulse and 100 uT at 1 cm (p.2 [680]). That is the exposure nearest to this helmet, and it found no difference from sham in 55 patients. Not a depression treatment: do not stop or change medication or treatment. Not for people with epilepsy; stop on headache, nausea or distress.
setting: Awake and seated, at home or in a quiet room.
schedule: Original: 30 min once a day for 5-8 weeks (Danish practice: 56 daily sessions); twice daily added nothing (Straasø 2014).
source: Larsen et al. 2020, Eur Psychiatry (pulse description) https://vbn.aau.dk/ws/files/330286808/transcranial_pulsed_electromagnetic_fields_for_treatmentresistant_depression_a_multicenter_8week_singlearm_cohort_study.pdf ; Tang et al. 2026, Brain Stimul (Re5 coil layout and field model) https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC13103953/ ; Martiny et al. 2010, Biol Psychiatry https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20385376/ ; van Belkum et al. 2021, J Affect Disord https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34333176/ ; Straasø et al. 2014, Acta Neuropsychiatr https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/25241755/
